metadata.name: sra_handler
metadata.description: SRA Handler — bridge-agnostic, mint-agnostic source + destination handler

accounts.name: executor
docs: Must be in the route's `allowed_executors`; gated in the handler.

accounts.name: route
docs: The route whose committed actions run. Not seed-bound here (that needs
`route_config_hash`, which `execute_actions` does not require): the
`fill_receipt` PDA below is seeded by `route.key()`, so passing any other
route would fail to find a finalized receipt — and per the single-tenant
trust model a route only ever touches its own execution authority.

accounts.name: fill_receipt
docs: The replay/lifecycle marker; bound to `route` + `fill_id` by its seeds.

accounts.name: execution_authority
docs: by seeds and signs the `SplTransfer` payouts and the vault->scratch move.

accounts.name: instructions_sysvar
docs: price quote backing a `VerifiedCpi` action's `min_out`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Permissionless caller (relayer / cranker). Pays the receipt rent.

accounts.name: verified_fill
docs: owner ∈ `route.allowed_adapters`, pins the account to its canonical PDA, and
validates the layout via `VerifiedFillData::deserialize_from_account`.

accounts.name: fill_receipt
docs: The replay marker. `init` (never `init_if_needed`) — a second
finalization of the same fill collides on this PDA and aborts.

accounts.name: expected_mint
docs: Bound to the route's committed mint; decimals are read live for
`transfer_checked` (never snapshotted).

accounts.name: owner
docs: Recovery authority (route owner).

accounts.name: fill_receipt
docs: The fill lifecycle marker.

accounts.name: expected_mint
docs: Decimals read live for transfer_checked.

accounts.name: owner_token_account
docs: Payout target: the owner's canonical ATA.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Receives the closed PDA's rent.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Receives the closed PDA's rent.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Only the route owner may retry.

accounts.name: route
docs: `has_one = owner`; not seed-bound (the `fill_receipt` PDA is seeded by `route`).

accounts.name: fill_receipt
docs: Replay/lifecycle marker: gates on `ActionsFailed`, advanced on a clean
re-run, never closed.

accounts.name: fee_payer
docs: Pays tx fees. Separated from `owner` to enable gas sponsorship.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Owns the source ATA and authorizes the user->vault transfer.

accounts.name: adapter_authority
docs: the derivation.

accounts.name: protocol_fee_config
docs: == no protocol fee configured — existence is read in-body, never
caller-claimed.

accounts.name: asset_fee_tier
docs: data == no tier, fall back to `default_fee_bps`.

accounts.name: fee_recipient_token_account
docs: Canonical ATA(fee_config.fee_recipient, source_mint)

types.name: AccountTemplate
docs: Ordered account-slot policy for a `VerifiedCpi`'s inner instruction. Slot
order matches the inner CPI's account list; each slot is pinned by the
handler (`Fixed`) or supplied by the relayer as routing (`Free`).

types.name: ActionsExecuted
docs: Emitted by `execute_actions` when every committed action applied and the
receipt advanced to `ActionsSucceeded` (terminal).

types.name: ActionsFailed
docs: Emitted by `execute_actions` / `retry_actions` when an action could not be
applied; the receipt is `ActionsFailed` and funds stay staged for retry or
recovery. No transfers from this run persist.

types.name: ActionsRetried
docs: Emitted by `retry_actions` on a successful re-run (receipt -> `ActionsSucceeded`).
Distinct from `ActionsExecuted` so indexers see the success came via a retry.

types.name: AddressBookEntry
docs: Per-address-book-root owner-managed (source_mint, chain, target_token) -> decimals registry.
`target_decimals = 0` is a tombstone/disabled entry, mirroring zeroed EVM TokenInfo.
PDA seeds: ["address_book", address_book_root, source_mint, chain_id.to_le_bytes(), target_token]

fields.name: target_decimals
docs: Decimals of `target_token` on the target chain. Serves three roles:
(a) canonical record for downstream amount math, (b) EVM-parity
existence sentinel, (c) tombstone marker when `0`. Tokens with 0
real decimals are not representable here — not a concern for USDC
and other bridgeable tokens, but worth knowing.

types.name: AddressBookRoot
docs: Owner-managed source address-book namespace. The root account is initialized
explicitly and then committed inside immutable `SourceHandlerData`.

types.name: AssetFeeTier
docs: Per-mint volume tier (EVM `assetFeeConfigs[asset]`).
PDA seeds: ["asset_fee_tier", mint]

fields.name: threshold
docs: Amount boundary in the mint's native units.

fields.name: below_bps
docs: Fee bps when amount < threshold; <= MAX_FEE_BPS.

fields.name: above_or_equal_bps
docs: Fee bps when amount >= threshold; <= MAX_FEE_BPS.

types.name: CreateRouteParams
docs: Inputs to `create_route`. Identity fields are folded into `route_config_hash`
(the route PDA); `allowed_adapters` is the only later-mutable policy.

fields.name: allowed_executors
docs: Executor allowlist; empty allowed.

types.name: DepositPrepared
docs: Emitted by `validate_and_prepare` after funds reach adapter custody. Carries
the routing inputs needed to build the target-specific bridge message.

fields.name: sra_config
docs: SraConfig PDA the deposit was prepared for.

fields.name: source_mint
docs: Source mint that was locked.

fields.name: adapter_program
docs: Allowlisted adapter program for the prepared deposit.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Nonce captured before the prepare handler increments it.

fields.name: input_amount
docs: Gross tokens pulled from the owner ATA into the SRA vault. The amount
forwarded to adapter custody and bridged in the same transaction is
`input_amount - protocol_fee_amount`.

fields.name: protocol_fee_amount
docs: Protocol fee collected on the source. Zero when fees are
disabled globally, no protocol-fee config is set, or the deposit is
sponsored.

fields.name: output_amount
docs: Minimum output amount the destination must honor; enforced here via
the slippage check (floored from the GROSS input)
and re-honored by the target-specific adapter flow.

fields.name: target_chain_id
docs: Runtime target chain id from `PrepareParams`.

fields.name: target_handler
docs: Opaque 32-byte target handler identifier. EVM handlers are left-padded
addresses; non-EVM targets may use all 32 bytes.

fields.name: target_adapter
docs: Opaque 32-byte target adapter identifier. EVM adapters are left-padded
addresses; non-EVM targets may use all 32 bytes.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Destination account / recipient identifier.

fields.name: target_token
docs: Per-deposit target token identifier. Stored as raw bytes32 so Solana
pubkeys and other non-EVM ids are not truncated.

types.name: ExecutionStatus
docs: Execution status state machine for fill lifecycle.
Borsh-serialized as a single u8 discriminant (no variant data). Size = 1 byte.

types.name: FeeConfig
docs: Global fee state: admin + the single fee recipient.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Pubkey::default() = none (2-step admin transfer).

fields.name: fee_recipient
docs: Pubkey::default() = fees disabled globally.

types.name: FillFinalized
docs: Emitted by `finalize_fill` once the verified amount is staged in the
execution vault and the replay-marker receipt is written. Carries the
post-write fill lifecycle state for indexers. There are no fees on the
destination (collected on the source), so none appear here.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount moved route_vault -> execution_vault (the full verified amount).

fields.name: expected_amount
docs: Source-committed minimum the fill had to satisfy.

types.name: FillReceipt
docs: Replay protection + execution lifecycle.
PDA seeds: ["fill_receipt", route, fill_id]

types.name: FixedRole
docs: Handler-controlled roles a `Fixed` slot can take. `Source`, `Destination`,
`SigningAuthority`, and `OutputMint` MUST appear in every template (enforced by
`validate_action_config`) so a relayer cannot redirect the input or output, and
so the handler reads the output mint from a pinned account.

types.name: FundsRecovered
docs: Emitted by `recover_funds` when the execution vault is drained to the owner.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount drained to the owner.

types.name: ManageRouteParams
docs: Inputs to `manage_route` — the route's only mutable policy (identity fields
are immutable, baked into `route_config_hash`). Each field is independently
optional: `None` leaves that policy unchanged.

fields.name: pause
docs: `Some(true)` pauses, `Some(false)` unpauses, `None` leaves it unchanged.

fields.name: adapters
docs: `Some` replaces the whole adapter allowlist (EVM `_installAdapters`
parity); `Some(vec![])` clears it; `None` leaves it unchanged.

fields.name: executors
docs: Whole-list replace, mirroring `adapters`; `Some(vec![])` clears (freezes execution).

types.name: MinOut
docs: Minimum-output reference for a `VerifiedCpi`'s post-fee balance-diff gate.

types.name: MintNonce
docs: Persistent nonce per `(sra_config, source_mint)`. The owner-signed deposit
flow will create it lazily and increment it per source-mint deposit.
PDA seeds: ["mint_nonce", sra_config, source_mint]

fields.name: input_amount
docs: Gross deposit; the protocol fee is deducted from this on the source.

fields.name: is_sponsor
docs: Owner-signed assertion that skips the protocol fee.

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps_override
docs: `NO_FEE_BPS_OVERRIDE` (u16::MAX) = no override.

types.name: ProtocolFeeConfig
docs: Single global protocol fee (EVM `protocolFeeConfig`). Deposits are the fee
payer, never a payee — all fees go to `FeeConfig.fee_recipient`.
PDA seeds: ["protocol_fee"]

fields.name: default_fee_bps
docs: Fallback when no asset tier matches; <= MAX_FEE_BPS.

fields.name: allow_override
docs: Honor a per-deposit bps override (EVM `allowOverride`).

types.name: RouteCreated
docs: Emitted by `create_route`. Carries the full route identity (post-write) for indexers.

fields.name: action_config_hash
docs: keccak256(borsh(action_config)) — committed by hash, not stored inline.

types.name: RouteManaged
docs: Emitted by `manage_route` with the post-write allowlists and paused flag.

types.name: SolanaAction
docs: A pre-registered action to execute on the destination chain after fill
finalization. v1: `SplTransfer` (static, exact-match accounts) and
`VerifiedCpi` (dynamic accounts, outcome-verified).

fields.name: amount_bps
docs: Basis points of the execution vault balance to transfer (e.g., 10000 = 100%).

fields.name: program_id
docs: Pinned program — checked loader-owned-executable + exact pubkey at execution.

fields.name: input_mint
docs: Token spent from the vault (usually `expected_mint`).

fields.name: input_bps
docs: Basis points of the vault moved into the scratch source — the input bound.

fields.name: output_mint
docs: Fungible receipt the engine balance-diffs (swap output, vault share, LST, …).

fields.name: allow_permissioned_output
docs: Opt-in for Token-2022 permissioned (perm-delegate / frozen) output mints.

types.name: SolanaSraRoute
docs: Deterministic destination address for EVM->Solana fills.
PDA seeds: ["sra_route", owner, config_hash, salt]
config_hash = keccak256(borsh(owner, source_chain_id, expected_mint, action_config))

fields.name: action_config_hash
docs: keccak256(borsh(action_config)). The action list is also folded into the
route's config_hash, but stored only as this digest; callers re-supply the
list as ix data and verify it against this hash, keeping the account small.

fields.name: allowed_executors
docs: Owner-managed; not in `route_config_hash` (mutable, like `allowed_adapters`).
Empty = no caller can `execute_actions`.

types.name: SourceHandlerData
docs: Owner-installed source policy. Committed at SRA install via
`handler_data_hash` (folded into the SRA's PDA identity) and re-supplied,
then re-authenticated, on every deposit. The routing tuple
(`target_chain_id` / `target_handler` / `target_adapter` / `recipient` /
`target_token`) is part of the immutable identity, mirroring the
EVM `RouteConfig` that `trigger()` reads from storage and a caller cannot
redirect (see `sra-stx/src/handler/SRAHandler.sol`). Every deposit must echo
this exact routing in `PrepareParams`; `validate_and_prepare` rejects any
divergence. Changing the route means a new SRA at a new address — the Solana
analogue of the EVM clone-proxy + `_onInstall` model.

types.name: SraConfig
docs: One source-side SRA per `(owner, final_handler, handler_data_hash, salt)`.
PDA seeds: ["sra", owner, config_hash, salt]
config_hash = keccak256(owner ‖ final_handler ‖ handler_data_hash)

types.name: VerifiedCpiRuntime
docs: Per-`VerifiedCpi`-action runtime data the relayer supplies to `execute_actions`,
one entry per `VerifiedCpi` action in action order. Carries the inner CPI's
instruction data plus the signed-quote fields (`min_amount_out`, `expiry`); the
quote's signature rides in a separate ed25519 instruction in the same
transaction. `min_amount_out`/`expiry` are bound into the quote message and
verified against the route-committed quoter, so a relayer cannot inflate them.

fields.name: inner_data
docs: The inner program's instruction data (relayer-built swap/deposit args).

fields.name: min_amount_out
docs: The signed quote's minimum acceptable output (the balance-diff floor).

fields.name: expiry
docs: The signed quote's unix expiry.
